open_points.subject: run start with an unknown flow
open_points.text: “A request naming a record that does not exist is refused as an unknown reference by the module that owns the record” contradicts “Start refusals of A12 rule 1, no run created: `module:runs`.”
open_points.question: When `start_run` names a nonexistent flow, does `module:flows` produce the unknown-reference refusal, or does `module:runs` produce it as an A12 start refusal?
options: `module:flows` produces the unknown-reference refusal and `module:runs` propagates it
`module:runs` produces every A12 start refusal, including an unknown flow
open_points.default_guess: `module:flows` produces the unknown-reference refusal; `module:runs` produces the no-active-version refusal for an existing flow.
